romaji: Asa no hachi-ji nanoni, juku no jishūshitsu ga mō manseki tte dō iu koto?
english: It's only 8 in the morning, but the cram school's self-study room is already full. What's going on?
exampleRomaji: Asa no hachi-ji nanoni, juku no jishūshitsu ga mō manseki tte dō iu koto?
japaneseFurigana: 朝(あさ)の8時なのに、塾(じゅく)の自習室(じしゅうしつ)がもう満席(まんせき)ってどういうこと？
exampleEn: It's only 8 in the morning, but the cram school's self-study room is already full. What's going on?
audioPath: clips/001_朝の8時なのに、塾の自習室がもう満席ってどういうこと.wav
grammar2:
〜なのに = despite
満(まん)席(せき) (full seats) ↔ 空(くう)席(せき) (empty seats)

romaji: Minna natsuyasumi dakara, asa hayaku kara kite benkyō shite irun da yo.
english: Everyone is on summer break, so they come early in the morning to study.
exampleRomaji: Minna natsuyasumi dakara, asa hayaku kara kite benkyō shite irun da yo.
japaneseFurigana: みんな夏(なつ)休(やす)みだから、朝(あさ)早(はや)くから来(き)て勉強(べんきょう)しているんだよ。
exampleEn: Everyone is on summer break, so they come early in the morning to study.
audioPath: clips/002_みんな夏休みだから、朝早くから来て勉強しているんだよ。.wav
grammar2:
朝(あさ)早(はや)く = early morning
〜ている = doing (continuous action)

romaji: Jukensei wa hontō ni hisshi da ne.
english: Exam students are really desperate, aren't they?
exampleRomaji: Jukensei wa hontō ni hisshi da ne.
japaneseFurigana: 受験生(じゅけんせい)は本当(ほんとう)に必死(ひっし)だね。
exampleEn: Exam students are really desperate, aren't they?
audioPath: clips/003_受験生は本当に必死だね。.wav
grammar2:
受(じゅ)験(けん)生(せい) = student preparing for exams
必(ひっ)死(し) = desperate/frantic

romaji: Watashitachi wa doko de benkyō sureba ii?
english: Where should we study?
exampleRomaji: Watashitachi wa doko de benkyō sureba ii?
japaneseFurigana: 私達(わたしたち)はどこで勉強(べんきょう)すればいい？
exampleEn: Where should we study?
audioPath: clips/004_私たちはどこで勉強すればいい.wav
grammar2: 〜ばいい = should do... / it would be best if...

romaji: Chikaku no toshokan ni itte miyō ka.
english: How about we try going to the nearby library?
exampleRomaji: Chikaku no toshokan ni itte miyō ka.
japaneseFurigana: 近(ちか)くの図書館(としょかん)に行(い)ってみようか。
exampleEn: How about we try going to the nearby library?
audioPath: clips/005_近くの図書館に行ってみようか。.wav
grammar2:
図(と)書(しょ)館(かん) = library
〜てみる = to try doing

romaji: Asoko nara shizuka da shi, seki ga aru kamo.
english: It's quiet there, and there might be seats available.
exampleRomaji: Asoko nara shizuka da shi, seki ga aru kamo.
japaneseFurigana: あそこなら静(しず)かだし、席(せき)があるかも。
exampleEn: It's quiet there, and there might be seats available.
audioPath: clips/006_あそこなら静かだし、席があるかも。.wav
grammar2:
静(しず)か (quiet) ↔ うるさい (noisy)
〜かも = might/perhaps

romaji: Sō da ne.
english: Yeah, that's right.
exampleRomaji: Sō da ne.
japaneseFurigana: そうだね。
exampleEn: Yeah, that's right.
audioPath: clips/007_そうだね。.wav

romaji: Natsuyasumi wa yūwaku ga ōkute, ie de wa zenzen shūchū dekinai n da yo ne.
english: During summer break, there are so many temptations that I can't focus at all at home.
exampleRomaji: Natsuyasumi wa yūwaku ga ōkute, ie de wa zenzen shūchū dekinai n da yo ne.
japaneseFurigana: 夏(なつ)休(やす)みは誘惑(ゆうわく)が多(おお)くて、家(いえ)では全然(ぜんぜん)集中(しゅうちゅう)できないんだよね。
exampleEn: During summer break, there are so many temptations that I can't focus at all at home.
audioPath: clips/008_夏休みは誘惑が多くて、家では全然集中できないんだよね。.wav
grammar2:
誘(ゆう)惑(わく) = temptation
全(ぜん)然(ぜん)〜ない = not at all

romaji: Wakaru yo.
english: I get it.
exampleRomaji: Wakaru yo.
japaneseFurigana: わかるよ。
exampleEn: I get it.
audioPath: clips/009_わかるよ。.wav

romaji: Terebi mo mitai shi, gēmu mo shitaku naru kara ne.
english: You want to watch TV and play games too, right?
exampleRomaji: Terebi mo mitai shi, gēmu mo shitaku naru kara ne.
japaneseFurigana: テレビも見(み)たいし、ゲームもしたくなるからね。
exampleEn: You want to watch TV and play games too, right?
audioPath: clips/010_テレビも見たいし、ゲームもしたくなるからね。.wav
grammar2:
〜たい = want to do
〜たくなる = to become wanting to do

romaji: Juku no kakikōshū, mainichi san kurasu mo aru kara hontō ni tsukareru.
english: I'm really exhausted because the cram school's summer course has three classes every day.
exampleRomaji: Juku no kakikōshū, mainichi san kurasu mo aru kara hontō ni tsukareru.
japaneseFurigana: 塾(じゅく)の夏(か)期(き)講習(こうしゅう)、毎日(まいにち)3クラスもあるから本当(ほんとう)に疲(つか)れる。
exampleEn: I'm really exhausted because the cram school's summer course has three classes every day.
audioPath: clips/011_塾の書き講習、毎日3クラスもあるから本当に疲れる。.wav
grammar2:
夏(か)期(き)講(こう)習(しゅう) = summer intensive course
疲(つか)れる = to get tired

romaji: Natsu wa juken no tennōzan tte sensei ga itte ita no o omoidasu yo.
english: I remember the teacher saying that summer is the critical period for entrance exams.
exampleRomaji: Natsu wa juken no tennōzan tte sensei ga itte ita no o omoidasu yo.
japaneseFurigana: 夏(なつ)は受験(じゅけん)の天(てん)王(おう)山(ざん)って先(せん)生(せい)が言(い)っていたのを思(おも)い出(だ)すよ。
exampleEn: I remember the teacher saying that summer is the critical period for entrance exams.
audioPath: clips/012_夏は受験の天皇山って先生が言っていたのを思い出すよ。.wav
grammar2:
天(てん)王(おう)山(ざん) = critical juncture (crucial period deciding victory or defeat)
思(おも)い出(だ)す = to remember

romaji: Tennōzan tte dō iu imi?
english: What does 'Tennōzan' mean?
exampleRomaji: Tennōzan tte dō iu imi?
japaneseFurigana: 天王山(てんのうざん)ってどういう意味(いみ)？
exampleEn: What does 'Tennōzan' mean?
audioPath: clips/013_天皇山ってどういう意味.wav
grammar2: 意(い)味(み) = meaning

romaji: Ichiban taisetsu na jiki tte iu imi da yo.
english: It means the most important period.
exampleRomaji: Ichiban taisetsu na jiki tte iu imi da yo.
japaneseFurigana: 一番(いちばん)大切(たいせつ)な時期(じき)っていう意味(いみ)だよ。
exampleEn: It means the most important period.
audioPath: clips/014_一番大切な時期っていう意味だよ。.wav
grammar2:
時(じ)期(き) = period/phase
大(たい)切(せつ) = important

romaji: Koko de ganbaranai to gōkaku dekinai n da tte.
english: They say you won't pass unless you work hard here.
exampleRomaji: Koko de ganbaranai to gōkaku dekinai n da tte.
japaneseFurigana: ここで頑張(がんば)らないと、合格(ごうかく)できないんだって。
exampleEn: They say you won't pass unless you work hard here.
audioPath: clips/015_ここで頑張らないと合格できないんだって。.wav
grammar2:
頑(がんば)る = to work hard
合(ごう)格(かく) (passing an exam) ↔ 不(ふ)合(ごう)格(かく) (failing an exam)

romaji: Naruhodo ne.
english: I see.
exampleRomaji: Naruhodo ne.
japaneseFurigana: なるほどね。
exampleEn: I see.
audioPath: clips/016_なるほどね。.wav

romaji: Kyō no tesuto no junbi wa dekita?
english: Are you ready for today's test?
exampleRomaji: Kyō no tesuto no junbi wa dekita?
japaneseFurigana: 今日(きょう)のテストの準備(じゅんび)はできた？
exampleEn: Are you ready for today's test?
audioPath: clips/017_今日のテストの準備はできた.wav
grammar2: 準(じゅん)備(び) = preparation

romaji: Iya, kinō no fukushū ga owatte inakute chotto shinpai da yo.
english: No, I'm a bit worried because I haven't finished reviewing yesterday's material.
exampleRomaji: Iya, kinō no fukushū ga owatte inakute chotto shinpai da yo.
japaneseFurigana: いや、昨日(きのう)の復習(ふくしゅう)が終(お)わっていなくて、ちょっと心配(しんぱい)だよ。
exampleEn: No, I'm a bit worried because I haven't finished reviewing yesterday's material.
audioPath: clips/018_いや、昨日の復習が終わっていなくてちょっと心配だよ。.wav
grammar2:
復(ふく)習(しゅう) (review) ↔ 予(よ)習(しゅう) (preparation)
心(しん)配(ぱい) (worried) ↔ 安(あん)心(しん) (relieved)

romaji: Jā, toshokan ni tsuitara otagai ni wakaranai tokoro o oshieaō.
english: Well, once we get to the library, let's teach each other the parts we don't understand.
exampleRomaji: Jā, toshokan ni tsuitara otagai ni wakaranai tokoro o oshieaō.
japaneseFurigana: じゃあ、図書館(としょかん)に着(つ)いたら、お互(たが)いに分(わ)からないところを教(おし)え合(あ)おう。
exampleEn: Well, once we get to the library, let's teach each other the parts we don't understand.
audioPath: clips/019_じゃあ、図書館に着いたらお互いに分からないところを教え合おう。.wav
grammar2:
お互(たが)いに = each other
〜合(あ)う = to do together

romaji: Tasukaru yo.
english: That would really help me out.
exampleRomaji: Tasukaru yo.
japaneseFurigana: 助(たす)かるよ。
exampleEn: That would really help me out.
audioPath: clips/020_助かるよ。.wav
grammar2: 助(たす)かる = to be helpful/saved

romaji: Toku ni suugaku no koushiki ga zenzen oboerarenakute komatte itanda.
english: I was really struggling because I just couldn't memorize the math formulas at all.
exampleRomaji: Toku ni suugaku no koushiki ga zenzen oboerarenakute komatte itanda.
japaneseFurigana: 特(とく)に数学(すうがく)の公式(こうしき)が全然(ぜんぜん)覚(おぼ)えられなくて困(こま)っていたんだ。
exampleEn: I was really struggling because I just couldn't memorize the math formulas at all.
audioPath: clips/021_特に数学の公式が全然覚えられなくて困っていたんだ。.wav
grammar2:
公(こう)式(しき) = formula
困(こま)る = to be in trouble

romaji: Suugaku nara watashi ga oshiete ageru.
english: If it's math, I can teach you.
exampleRomaji: Suugaku nara watashi ga oshiete ageru.
japaneseFurigana: 数学(すうがく)なら私(わたし)が教(おし)えてあげる。
exampleEn: If it's math, I can teach you.
audioPath: clips/022_数学なら私が教えてあげる。.wav
grammar2: 〜てあげる = to do something for someone

romaji: Sono kawari eigo o oshiete ne.
english: In return, could you teach me English?
exampleRomaji: Sono kawari eigo o oshiete ne.
japaneseFurigana: その代(か)わり、英語(えいご)を教(おし)えてね。
exampleEn: In return, could you teach me English?
audioPath: clips/023_その代わり英語を教えてね。.wav
grammar2: その代(か)わり = in return

romaji: Ii yo.
english: Sure, that works for me.
exampleRomaji: Ii yo.
japaneseFurigana: いいよ。
exampleEn: Sure, that works for me.
audioPath: clips/024_いいよ。.wav

romaji: Eigo no choubun dokkai no kotsu o oshiete ageru.
english: I'll teach you some tips for reading long English passages.
exampleRomaji: Eigo no choubun dokkai no kotsu o oshiete ageru.
japaneseFurigana: 英語(えいご)の長文(ちょうぶん)読解(どっかい)のコツを教(おし)えてあげる。
exampleEn: I'll teach you some tips for reading long English passages.
audioPath: clips/025_英語の長文読解のコツを教えてあげる。.wav
grammar2:
長(ちょう)文(ぶん) (long passage) ↔ 短(たん)文(ぶん) (short sentence)
コツ = knack/tips

romaji: Yoshi.
english: Alright!
exampleRomaji: Yoshi.
japaneseFurigana: よーし。
exampleEn: Alright!
audioPath: clips/026_よーし。.wav

romaji: Jaa hayaku toshokan e ikou.
english: Well then, let's hurry to the library.
exampleRomaji: Jaa hayaku toshokan e ikou.
japaneseFurigana: じゃあ早(はや)く図(と)書(しょ)館(かん)へ行(い)こう。
exampleEn: Well then, let's hurry to the library.
audioPath: clips/027_じゃあ早く図書館へ行こう。.wav
grammar2: 早(はや)く (early/quickly) ↔ 遅(おそ)く (late/slowly)

romaji: Aruite iru dake de ase ga detekuru ne.
english: Just walking makes me sweat, doesn't it?
exampleRomaji: Aruite iru dake de ase ga detekuru ne.
japaneseFurigana: 歩(ある)いているだけで汗(あせ)が出(で)てくるね。
exampleEn: Just walking makes me sweat, doesn't it?
audioPath: clips/028_歩いているだけで汗が出てくるね。.wav
grammar2:
〜だけで = just by
〜てくる = to start to

romaji: Hontou ni atsui.
english: It's really hot.
exampleRomaji: Hontou ni atsui.
japaneseFurigana: 本当(ほんとう)に暑(あつ)い。
exampleEn: It's really hot.
audioPath: clips/029_本当に暑い。.wav
grammar2: 暑(あつ)い (hot) ↔ 寒(さむ)い (cold)

romaji: Reibou no kiita heya ni hayaku hairitai yo.
english: I want to get into an air-conditioned room quickly.
exampleRomaji: Reibou no kiita heya ni hayaku hairitai yo.
japaneseFurigana: 冷房(れいぼう)の効(き)いた部屋(へや)に早(はや)く入(はい)りたいよ。
exampleEn: I want to get into an air-conditioned room quickly.
audioPath: clips/030_冷房の効いた部屋に早く入りたいよ。.wav
grammar2: 冷(れい)房(ぼう) (air conditioning) ↔ 暖(だん)房(ぼう) (heating)

romaji: Konbini de tsumetai nomimono o katte kara ikou.
english: Let's buy a cold drink at the convenience store and then go.
exampleRomaji: Konbini de tsumetai nomimono o katte kara ikou.
japaneseFurigana: コンビニで冷(つめ)たい飲(の)み物(もの)を買(か)ってから行(い)こう。
exampleEn: Let's buy a cold drink at the convenience store and then go.
audioPath: clips/031_コンビニで冷たい飲み物を買ってから行こう.wav
grammar2:
冷(つめ)たい (cold) ↔ 温(あたた)かい (warm)
〜てから = after doing

romaji: Suibun hokyuu wa taisetsu da kara ne.
english: Staying hydrated is important, you know.
exampleRomaji: Suibun hokyuu wa taisetsu da kara ne.
japaneseFurigana: 水分補給(すいぶんほきゅう)は大切(たいせつ)だからね。
exampleEn: Staying hydrated is important, you know.
audioPath: clips/032_水分補給は大切だからね.wav
grammar2: 水(すい)分(ぶん)補(ほ)給(きゅう) = hydration
